title: Inline publish token is passed through process argv
reasoning: The executor explicitly accepts an inline registry token and forwards it as a cargo command-line argument. The warning acknowledges that this leaks the secret into process listings, but the executor still performs the unsafe action, so a caller can expose a publish credential on shared CI runners or local multi-user systems.
reproduction: Invoke the release-publish executor with a token option; the resulting cargo publish command receives --token <secret> in argv.
recommendation: Remove the token option from the executor contract, or reject it at runtime with a clear error and require CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN or another non-argv secret channel.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included for this feature, and the current code path intentionally appends the token to argv rather than asserting that token-based configuration is rejected.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a release-publish executor test that passes token and asserts the executor fails before calling cargoCommand, while a CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN environment-based path remains supported.
minimumFixScope: Update src/executors/release-publish/executor.ts to stop forwarding options.token, and update any executor schema/docs/tests that advertise inline token support.
